impacts.text: An attacker can permanently prevent the contract owner from unregistering a vault by sending a dust amount of the vault's underlying asset directly to the vault's address.
This is a permanent Denial of Service on a core governance function.
Because the assets cannot be removed, the owner can never unregister the vault.
The owner cannot remove old, compromised, or buggy vaults.
It hinders the owner's ability to perform upgrades or migrate the system to a new set of contracts.
It creates a permanent, undeletable entry in the Share Token's vault registry, which can lead to clutter and confusion for off-chain systems.
